**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement contains no auto-renewal trap for us:

- **§10 (p0065)** — maintenance is provided "For a renewable one-year term," i.e. a 12-month term extendable only by the parties' affirmative agreement. No "automatically renew" language exists anywhere in the document (searches for "renew", "automatically renew" and "increase" returned nothing else).
- **§17(a) (p0117)** — the licence is perpetual so long as fees are paid, so there is no rolling term to escape.
- **§17(b) (p0118)** — Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' written notice, an unconditional customer exit right.

With no automatic renewal there is no non-renewal notice window to compute and no multi-year renewal risk, so this sits at the **preferred** position rather than the fallback.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged (minor sub-elements per the classification rules): there is no express cap on maintenance fee uplift for renewal terms (fees are simply "in accordance with the Fee Schedule"), and no vendor renewal reminder. The CPI/3% uplift cap is better pursued in the Fee Schedule negotiation than by redlining §10.
